title: C4OS Grill Question 014 - Settings Placement

answer_key.What happens to visible plugin panels wh: Close all plugin panels, then restore per-chat panels when leaving Settings

questions.label: Where should Settings open in the plugin-first shell?
questions.help: Recommended: center pane shell route. This avoids reintroducing right-panel tabs and gives Settings enough space for Plugins, Runtime, Configuration, Skills, and approval-policy screens.

questions.label: What happens to visible plugin panels when Settings opens?
questions.help: Recommended: keep panels visible unless the user closes them. Settings becomes center content, not a panel-layout reset.
options: Close only panels that conflict with width
Restore per-chat panels when leaving Settings

questions.help: Clarify whether Settings is global, per-session, per-workspace, or whether some Settings pages should open as dialogs.
